metadata.description: PSD Plugin Marketplace for Claude Code and Claude Cowork — coding workflows, productivity agents, and district automation

plugins.name: psd-coding-system
plugins.description: AI-assisted development system — 3 disciplined surfaces (/plan, /lfg, /evolve), verification-first run-to-100%-clean PR loop, specialized agents, memory-based learning, and Context7 framework docs

plugins.name: psd-productivity
plugins.description: 33 productivity workflows + 1 agent — Google-style tech writing, ParentSquare district data CLI, Atrium publishing (AI Studio docs + HTML artifacts), beautiful HTML artifact generation (incl. self-contained data dashboards & charts), board policy formatting, PDF Builder, Documenso document signing, n8n workflow automation, document generation, research, TTS, enrollment automation, browser control, Google Workspace, and district operations

plugins.name: n8n
plugins.description: MCP connection to PSD's n8n instance (n8n-instance server). Opt-in, starts disabled; needs N8N_HOST and N8N_MCP_TOKEN. Pairs with /n8n-manager in psd-productivity

plugins.name: documenso
plugins.description: MCP connection to PSD's Documenso instance (official SDK server). Opt-in, starts disabled; needs DOCUMENSO_API_KEY. Pairs with /documenso-manager in psd-productivity

plugins.name: collab
plugins.description: Threads between people's Claude Code agents: the collab server, a pane for sorting threads by project, and notice of replies
